questions: Should the output be exactly M lines, one for each k from 0 to M-1 in order, even if M is larger than N or if some k produce the same inversion count?

Are the input values A_i guaranteed to be distinct, or can there be duplicates?
Should the solution compute inversion counts for all k efficiently, or is it acceptable to brute force each k independently given constraints?
